<style>
.sim-console{--bezel1:#1a1f1b;--bezel2:#0d110e;--panel:#0a150e;--panel2:#0c1c12;--edge:#2f6b3f;--edge2:#1d4227;--ink:#8ee39a;--ink-dim:#4f8f5e;--ink-bright:#c9ffd4;--amber:#e0b83a;--red:#e0554a;--blue:#58a6ff;--grn:#6fe08a;--lock-ring:15px;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:100%;height:100%;max-height:100%;overflow:hidden;padding:6px;background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%,#171c18 0%,#090c0a 70%);font-family:"DejaVu Sans Mono","Roboto Mono",Consolas,monospace;color:var(--ink);font-size:11px;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:.02em;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.sim-console *{box-sizing:border-box}
.sim-console .bezel{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;padding:5px;border:2px solid #242a25;border-radius:7px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bezel1),var(--bezel2));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #000,inset 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.8);overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .screen{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;padding:5px;border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#08120c,#050a07 60%,#07100b);box-shadow:inset 0 0 50px rgba(20,120,50,.10),inset 0 0 0 1px #0c2413;overflow:hidden}

.sim-console .topbar{flex:0 0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(170px,1fr) auto minmax(150px,auto);gap:8px;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--edge2);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d1d12,#091209);padding:1px 8px;border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .brand{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;min-width:0}
.sim-console [data-slot="system-name"]{height:18px;min-width:150px;display:block;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.10em;color:var(--ink-bright);text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(110,230,140,.35);overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .brand .sub{font-size:8px;color:var(--ink-dim);letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.sim-console .statechips{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;flex-wrap:nowrap;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .chip{border:1px solid var(--edge2);padding:1px 6px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.10em;color:var(--ink-dim);background:#08130c;border-radius:2px;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.sim-console .chip.on{color:var(--ink-bright);border-color:var(--edge);background:#0f2a18;box-shadow:inset 0 0 10px rgba(80,200,110,.18)}
.sim-console .clockwrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:0}
.sim-console .clockwrap .lab{font-size:7.5px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--ink-dim)}
.sim-console [data-slot="clock"]{height:21px;min-width:142px;display:block;padding:0 6px;border:1px solid var(--edge);background:#061009;font-size:14px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--amber);text-align:right;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(224,184,58,.3);overflow:hidden}

/* ANCHORED LAYOUT: side columns are fixed px, the scope takes every remaining pixel.
   Injected content (interception messages, long track lists) can never widen a column
   or grow a row, so the radar port keeps its size. */
.sim-console .main{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;display:grid;gap:4px;overflow:hidden;grid-template-columns:70px minmax(0,1fr) 262px 142px;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:"rail scope picture res"}
.sim-console .rail{grid-area:rail;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .scope{grid-area:scope;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .picture{grid-area:picture;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .right{grid-area:res;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}

.sim-console .panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--edge2);border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel2),var(--panel));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.sim-console .panel>.hd{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;padding:1px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge2);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#123321,#0b1e12);font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-bright);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .panel>.hd .r{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink-dim);text-transform:none;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.sim-console .panel>.bd{flex:1 1 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;padding:2px}
.sim-console .scope>.bd{padding:2px}

.sim-console .kv{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px;font-size:7.5px;padding:0;border-bottom:1px dotted #14351f}
.sim-console .kv:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.sim-console .kv b{color:var(--ink-bright);font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.sim-console .kv span{color:var(--ink-dim)}
.sim-console .kv.warn b{color:var(--amber)}
.sim-console .grouplab{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.10em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-dim);margin:2px 0 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge2)}
.sim-console .grouplab:first-child{margin-top:0}

/* range / scale control strip \u2014 live control is rendered into the slot */
.sim-console .rangebar{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;height:17px;padding:0 1px 1px;margin-bottom:1px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge2);font-size:7.5px;letter-spacing:.10em;color:var(--ink-dim);text-transform:uppercase;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .rangebar .zlab{white-space:nowrap}
.sim-console [data-slot="range"]{flex:1 1 auto;display:block;min-width:0;height:15px;overflow:hidden}

.sim-console .scopewrap{position:relative;flex:1 1 auto;display:flex;align-items:stretch;justify-content:center;min-height:0;min-width:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(72% 72% at 50% 92%,rgba(15,61,31,.55) 0%,rgba(4,10,6,.15) 100%)}
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"]{position:absolute;inset:0;display:block;min-height:0;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;overscroll-behavior:contain;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"]:active{cursor:grabbing}
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] *{touch-action:none}
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
/* lock-on / selection marker: tight ring hugging the track symbol only */
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] .lock-ring,.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] .sel-ring,.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] circle.lock,.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] circle.selected{r:9px;fill:none;stroke:var(--amber);stroke-width:1.2;stroke-dasharray:3 3}
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] div.lock-ring,.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] div.sel-ring{width:var(--lock-ring);height:var(--lock-ring);margin:calc(var(--lock-ring) / -2) 0 0 calc(var(--lock-ring) / -2);border:1px dashed var(--amber);border-radius:50%;background:none}
.sim-console .scopefoot{flex:0 0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:0 6px;height:11px;padding-top:1px;border-top:1px solid var(--edge2);font-size:7.5px;color:var(--ink-dim);letter-spacing:.04em;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}

/* TRACK READOUT: the injected table owns its own header row. Columns are sized for every
   profile field plus the IFF code the runtime reports for each track; nothing here may
   hide, collapse or clip that column. */
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"]{flex:1 1 auto;display:block;min-height:0;min-width:0;padding:1px;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;font-size:8px;line-height:1.12;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(30,90,50,.07) 0 16px,transparent 16px 32px)}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;table-layout:auto;font-size:8px}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] td{padding:1px 2px;white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:left;overflow:visible;text-overflow:clip}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th{font-size:6.5px;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-dim);border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge2);position:sticky;top:0;background:#0b1e12;z-index:1}
/* IFF code cell: force it visible whatever markup the runtime uses, and never let it be
   the column that gets squeezed away. Empty IFF reads as a dash, not as blank space. */
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] .iff,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] .iff-code,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] .iffcode,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] .col-iff,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] .track-iff,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] .squawk,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] .mode3,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [data-field="iff"],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [data-col="iff"],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [data-key="iff"],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [data-iff],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [data-field*="iff" i],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [data-col*="iff" i],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [class*="iff" i],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [headers~="iff"]{display:table-cell!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important;width:auto!important;max-width:none!important;color:var(--ink-bright);letter-spacing:.02em}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th.iff,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th[data-field="iff"],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th[data-col="iff"],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th[class*="iff" i]{display:table-cell!important;color:var(--ink-dim)}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] td:empty::after{content:"\2013";color:var(--ink-dim)}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] td[class*="iff" i]:empty::after,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] td[data-field*="iff" i]:empty::after{content:"NO IFF";font-size:6.5px;color:var(--ink-dim)}

.sim-console [data-slot="resources"]{flex:1 1 auto;display:block;min-height:0;min-width:0;padding:1px;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;font-size:8px;line-height:1.12}
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] *{font-size:inherit;line-height:inherit}

.sim-console .legend{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
.sim-console .lrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:8px 1fr auto;gap:4px;align-items:center;font-size:8px;padding:0}
.sim-console .sw{width:7px;height:7px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:1px}
.sim-console .sw.f{background:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(88,166,255,.5)}
.sim-console .sw.g{background:var(--grn);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(111,224,138,.45)}
.sim-console .sw.n{background:var(--amber);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(224,184,58,.45)}
.sim-console .sw.h{background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(224,85,74,.5)}
.sim-console .lrow b{font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-bright)}
.sim-console .lrow em{font-style:normal;font-size:6.5px;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--ink-dim);text-transform:uppercase}

.sim-console .footer{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .decision{flex:0 0 auto}
.sim-console .decision>.bd{gap:1px;padding:1px 4px 2px}
.sim-console .seqhint{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;flex-wrap:nowrap;gap:3px;font-size:6.5px;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--ink-dim);text-transform:uppercase;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}
.sim-console .seqhint u{text-decoration:none;border:1px solid var(--edge2);padding:0 4px;border-radius:2px;background:#08130c}
.sim-console .seqhint u.ammo{border-color:#7a6420;color:#c9b26a}
/* engagement control: compact type so every control \u2014 interceptor band select,
   launcher select, magazine / reload and the launch command \u2014 fits without a scroller */
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"]{display:block;flex:0 0 auto;height:124px;padding:1px;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;font-size:8px;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:.02em}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] *{font-size:inherit;line-height:inherit;max-width:100%}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] h1,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] h2,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] h3,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] h4{font-size:7.5px;margin:0;letter-spacing:.07em}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] svg{max-height:26px}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] select,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] input,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] label,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] a{font-family:inherit;font-size:7.5px;letter-spacing:.03em;padding:1px 4px;line-height:1.1;min-height:0;min-width:0;border-radius:2px}

/* every control the runtime renders here gets real pressable chrome, whatever it is called */
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] [role="button"]{font-family:inherit;font-size:8.5px!important;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 8px!important;line-height:1.15;border-radius:2px;color:var(--ink-bright);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#12301d,#0a1a10);border:1px solid var(--edge);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(140,240,170,.10);cursor:pointer}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-pressed="true"],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.active,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.selected,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.on{color:#04170a!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fe6a2,#4fae66)!important;border-color:#b6ffc8!important;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(111,224,138,.35)}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[disabled],.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}

/* LAUNCH / FIRE / ENGAGE command: the one dominant red command in the row */
@keyframes fireGlow{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(255,70,50,.75),0 0 0 2px rgba(255,70,50,.25),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 34px rgba(255,90,70,.95),0 0 0 3px rgba(255,70,50,.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4)}}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.fire,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.engage,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.btn-fire,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.danger,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.primary,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="fire" i]:not([class*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="engage" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="shoot" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="launch" i]:not([class*="launcher" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="fire" i]:not([id*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="engage" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="launch" i]:not([id*="launcher" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[name*="fire" i]:not([name*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="fire" i]:not([value*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="launch" i]:not([value*="launcher" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="fire" i]:not([data-action*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="engage" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="launch" i]:not([data-action*="launcher" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-role*="fire" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="fire" i]:not([aria-label*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="engage" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="launch" i]:not([aria-label*="launcher" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] [role="button"][class*="fire" i]:not([class*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] [role="button"][class*="engage" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] [role="button"][class*="launch" i]:not([class*="launcher" i]){font-size:18px!important;font-weight:900!important;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:8px 30px!important;color:#fff4f0!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ff5f45 0%,#d32517 55%,#7d150e 100%)!important;border:2px solid #ff9c8c!important;border-radius:3px!important;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.8);animation:fireGlow 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="fire" i]:not([class*="cease" i]):disabled,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="launch" i]:not([class*="launcher" i]):disabled,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="engage" i]:disabled{animation:none;opacity:.5}
/* cease fire stays a subdued amber so it cannot be mistaken for the launch command */
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="cease" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="cease" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="cease" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="cease" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="cease" i]{font-size:8.5px!important;font-weight:600!important;padding:2px 8px!important;color:#f0dca0!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3a2f10,#221a08)!important;border:1px solid #7a6420!important;box-shadow:none!important;animation:none!important;text-shadow:none;letter-spacing:.08em}
/* reload / magazine / rearm command, wherever the runtime places it: clearly present, clearly not LAUNCH */
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="rearm" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="re-arm" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="magazine" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="resupply" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="replenish" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="rearm" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="magazine" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="rearm" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="magazine" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="rearm" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="magazine" i]{font-size:10px!important;font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:.10em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 12px!important;color:#04170a!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fe6a2,#3f9a58)!important;border:1px solid #b6ffc8!important;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(111,224,138,.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25)!important;animation:none!important;text-shadow:none}
/* the same hooks inside the resources panel, so a magazine / band control rendered there reads alike */
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button,.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] select,.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] [role="button"]{font-family:inherit;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:2px;color:var(--ink-bright);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#12301d,#0a1a10);border:1px solid var(--edge);cursor:pointer}
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button[aria-pressed="true"],.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button.active,.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button.selected{color:#04170a!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fe6a2,#4fae66)!important;border-color:#b6ffc8!important}
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button[class*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button[class*="rearm" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button[class*="magazine" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button[data-action*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button[data-action*="rearm" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button[data-action*="magazine" i]{font-size:9.5px!important;font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:.10em;padding:3px 9px!important;color:#04170a!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fe6a2,#3f9a58)!important;border:1px solid #b6ffc8!important;border-radius:2px}

.sim-console .keyrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:6px;align-items:center;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .fkeys{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,minmax(0,1fr));gap:3px}
.sim-console .fkey{padding:0;text-align:center;font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.04em;border:1px solid var(--edge2);border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0e2415,#081209);color:var(--ink-dim);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(120,220,150,.06)}
.sim-console .fkey.act{color:#04170a;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fe6a2,#4fae66);border-color:#8fe6a2}
.sim-console .fkey.off{color:#27452f;border-color:#152b1b}
.sim-console .plate{padding:0 10px;border:1px solid #4a3f1e;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3a3117,#221c0d);color:#c9b26a;font-size:7.5px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}

@media (max-width:1460px){
.sim-console .main{grid-template-columns:70px minmax(0,1fr) 230px;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:"rail scope res" "rail picture res"}
}
@media (max-width:1080px){
.sim-console .main{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 144px;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:"scope res" "picture res"}
.sim-console .rail{display:none}
}
@media (max-height:700px){
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"]{height:112px}
}
@media (max-height:620px){
.sim-console .footer .keyrow{display:none}
.sim-console .seqhint{display:none}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"]{height:104px}
}
</style>

<div class="sim-console">
 <div class="bezel">
  <div class="screen">

   <div class="topbar">
    <div class="brand">
     <div data-slot="system-name"></div>
     <div class="sub">Air Defence Operator Console · Fixed 120° Sector</div>
    </div>
    <div class="statechips">
     <div class="chip on">Surveillance</div>
     <div class="chip">Acquisition</div>
     <div class="chip">Engaged</div>
     <div class="chip">Rockets in air 0 / 2</div>
    </div>
    <div class="clockwrap">
     <div class="lab">Mission Clock / TTI</div>
     <div data-slot="clock"></div>
    </div>
   </div>

   <div class="main">

result.design_notes: Unchanged from before: the four-image layout (dark bezel, inset green CRT screen, status strip on top, left data rail, large left-hand PPI, right-hand track table over a lower detail panel, far-right resource column, F1\the amber caption plate at the foot) and the sampled palette \u2014 #050a07/#0a150e panel fills, #1d4227/#2f6b3f borders, #8ee39a ink, #c9ffd4 highlights, amber #e0b83a and the hostile red #e0554a used on the highlighted table row. The profile supplied the eight readout columns, the four identification states in the key, the 20/50/70 km engagement rings, the 120\u00b0 fixed-tilt sector and the two-rockets-in-the-air limit; the trajectory-analysis and diagnostics pages from the screenshots are generalised away as they carry no described capability. This revision (requests 7 and 8): the decision slot is taller (124 px) and every control the runtime renders into it now gets real pressable chrome by default \u2014 so the interceptor-band, launcher and reload/magazine buttons read as buttons whatever they are named \u2014 while the launch command is now 18 px, black-bold, in a saturated red gradient with a slow glow, and cease-fire is held down to a subdued amber; the same chrome hooks are mirrored in the resources slot in case the magazine controls are rendered there. Rule I could not bend: I cannot paint reload or magazine-select buttons into the shell myself, because a button with nothing behind it is worse than none \u2014 they must be emitted by the runtime into the wired decision (or resources) slot, which is now sized and styled to hold them. Side columns were trimmed again (70/262/142 px) with all their type reduced, so the anchored radar port grew once more; the IFF cell selectors were broadened (class, data-field, data-col, data-iff, squawk/mode3) and an empty IFF cell now prints \"NO IFF\" rather than collapsing.
